correctness.rationale: The all-parameter unsigned incidence Gram spectrum follows from equitable complete-tripartite adjacency eigenspaces; the Ihara–Bass/Schur polynomial identity is reconstructed with exact dimensions and multiplicities. Both residual quartics are strictly positive on real arguments, and block similarity yields the real normalized spectrum. The universal-cover lower-edge inequality has the exact threshold a>4+2sqrt(3). The included Python checker derives full charpolys independently via integer closed-walk traces for a=1..3, so no numerical approximation is used for those checks.

value.rationale: This is a motivated equality-case boundary for a newly formulated real-eigenvalue extremal theorem: it gives explicit infinite nonregular extremizers that are nevertheless non-two-sided-Ramanujan, locates a sharp finite a=8 threshold, and explains the obstruction structurally via purely imaginary Hashimoto roots. The graph family is canonical (incidence subdivisions of balanced complete tripartite graphs), not an arbitrary numerical slice.
